name: fix80_corpse
verifies: fix-80 #2-#4: dead bodies rest on the ground (no sinking) on flat ground and on a slope, for a ragdoll (an orc killed standing), a dying motion (a wolf; an orc finished on the ground) and a corpse met again after save/load (lies at once, no dying motion replayed); the origin (focus name, loot reach) is the middle of the lying body
steps: log -- flat: ragdoll (an orc killed standing)
spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=4 side=front as=o1
spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=4 side=left as=w1
log -- flat: an orc knocked out, then killed on the ground (the dying motion)
spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=4 side=right as=o2
spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=3 side=left as=o3
spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=3 side=right as=w3
log -- a placed NPC (survives save/load for sure): a cow
log -- save and load: the corpse lies at once in its pose, on the ground
notes: corpse:X is how the body came to rest (CorpseRest.Info: 'ragdoll: …', 'pose: tilt N°, moved ±m, origin moved m', 'restored pose: …'; 'falling' before). corpsegap = (fix-221: a ragdoll: the lowest clearance of its collision parts over the ground; a pose corpse:) the 2nd percentile of the skin's height above the ground (negative = sunk in; the authored LieDead pose is -0.11 before the fix), corpsepelvis = the Spine_Spine_1 bone above the ground (humanoids), corpseanchor = horizontal distance origin ↔ middle of the body (the focus name's x/z; ~1 m before the fix for the dying motion). dying = a dying motion is playing (must stay False right after a load: G3 shows a body met again in its ground pose).
